question: Which fast food is closest when progressing from Mountain Creek gold mine, New London, NC toward Old Vineyard Behavioral Health Services, Winston-Salem, NC?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.185301 35.43723)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.31855 36.078324)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.185301 35.43723)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.185301 35.43723)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Mountain Creek gold mine, New London, NC

[3].display_name: Old Vineyard Behavioral Health Services, Winston-Salem, NC
